title: i2c: format FIFO fields, the stop setup time and the format FIFO threshold
conditions: Programming the I2C host: entering format FIFO entries (R1), setting the timing registers (R2, R3) and waiting for a transfer (R4, R5).
C2 records a width in bits; the other settings are encoded as 1 if the statement about the design holds and 0 if it does not.

requirements.text: That is of one single format byte (entered into the format FIFO through [`FDATA.FBYTE`](registers.md#fdata)), and five 1-bit flags
requirements.note: The five flags are FDATA.READB, RCONT, START, STOP and NAKOK, named on the same line.
Step 1 of the timing parameter procedure: input T_STO_MIN into its register.

requirements.text: - **Or** if `INTR_STATE.FMT_THRESHOLD` bit is 1 ( as long as `FIFO_CTRL.FMTILVL` is set to 1).
requirements.note: Waiting for a transfer to finish.

requirements.text: then set `FIFO_CTRL.FMTRST` to reset the FMT FIFO

design.description: no field named T_STO (TIMING4's fields are TSU_STO and T_BUF)

design.text: Actual setup time for stop signals.

design.note: The core takes the stop setup time from TIMING4.TSU_STO.

design.description: no field named FMTILVL (FIFO_CTRL's fields are RXRST, FMTRST, ACQRST and TXRST; the format FIFO threshold is HOST_FIFO_CONFIG.FMT_THRESH, used in i2c_core.sv line 314)

design.text: desc: "FMT fifo reset. Write 1 to the register resets FMT_FIFO. Read returns 0"

design.note: A write of 1 to FMTRST resets the format FIFO.

claims.setting: FDATA has 1-bit fields READB, RCONT, START, STOP and NAKOK (1 yes, 0 no)
claims.label: agrees

claims.setting: TIMING4 has a field named T_STO (1 yes, 0 no)
claims.label: disagrees

claims.setting: the stop setup time is set in TIMING4 (1 yes, 0 no)
claims.label: agrees

claims.setting: FIFO_CTRL has a field named FMTILVL (1 yes, 0 no)
claims.label: disagrees

claims.setting: writing 1 to FIFO_CTRL.FMTRST resets the format FIFO (1 yes, 0 no)
claims.label: agrees

generated_from_same_input: D1 to D8, D10 and D11 are in i2c.hjson, from which reggen generates the register RTL and registers.md; those generated files are not counted as further evidence. D9 and D12 are in the hand-written i2c_core.sv. R1 to R5 are hand-written.
finding: The format FIFO entry, the timing register and the FIFO reset agree with the design. Two names do not: the stop setup time field is TIMING4.TSU_STO, not T_STO (R2, R3), and FIFO_CTRL has no FMTILVL field: the format FIFO threshold is HOST_FIFO_CONFIG.FMT_THRESH (R4).
missing_information: This case reads the register description and the core's assignments; it does not simulate a transfer. R4's "set to 1" is not compared with HOST_FIFO_CONFIG.FMT_THRESH's encoding.
ambiguities: T_STO is the name of the timing parameter (T_STO_MIN, line 52); R2 and R3 use it as a field name.
out_of_scope: The other timing fields in R2 and the example values in R3.
